title: Exploit Chain: Total service outage via supply-chain install failure + startup import regressions
description: Step 1 (Finding: requirements.txt pins nonexistent package): a fresh deployment runs `pip install -r backend/requirements.txt`; pydantic-email-validation==0.2.0 does not exist on PyPI (registry response: 'from versions: none'), so dependency resolution FAILS and the environment is never created. Step 2 (Finding: plan.py self-import): even if the install issue is worked around, importing app.api.routes.plans raises ImportError ('cannot import name PlanDB from partially initialized module', plan.py:6) and the FastAPI app cannot boot. Step 3 (Finding: contact router undefined classes): even after removing the self-import, importing app.api.routes.contact raises ImportError ('cannot import name ContactRequest') because the classes are defined nowhere. Result: the product is permanently unavailable at every deployment path; the only 'fix' commit in history (feb5207d) introduced the primary regression.
impact: Complete loss of service availability: no clean environment can install the dependencies, no code state can boot the backend, and all API endpoints plus the marketing site's backend features are dead.
mitigation: Break the chain at every link: (1) replace pydantic-email-validation with email-validator and verify a clean venv install; (2) remove the self-import at plan.py:6; (3) define ContactRequest/ContactResponse or remove the contact router stub; (4) add a CI startup smoke test (uvicorn boot + import app.main).
